from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class TaxExpenseRecord(BaseModel):
    """Captures the income tax expense figure from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in the report")
    tax_expense_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the income tax expense")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The monetary unit of the value (e.g., '元', '百万元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the expense")
    raw_text: str = Field(description="Original text snippet of the line item for verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    tax_expense_records: list[TaxExpenseRecord]
